These failures preceded owned-outer capture/reuse and native-interface corrections; they are not the current paired bridge result.
full_backbuffer_startup_trial.source_audit: Superseded initial theory: wrapper teardown order was suspected after the outstanding-reference failure. Later diagnosis identified ownership of the API-visible ReShade outer chain during GTA replacement. The targeted owned-outer capture/reuse remedy preserves that presentation chain; native D3D12 boundary corrections and the paired HUD bridge followed. A general teardown reorder is not the current conclusion.
